reader.requirement: At 1985 (as amended by X3.23b-1993, C315), when FUNCTION MIN has more than one argument-1 all must be of the same class, except that alphabetic and alphanumeric arguments may be mixed; the compiler must refuse a list mixing numeric with alphabetic/alphanumeric (including numeric-edited and group items, which are class alphanumeric) and accept every same-class or alphabetic/alphanumeric list.

reader.notes: MIN shares MAX's Verified row shape (Uniform 'p' + CrossArgRule.AllSameClass) and the one CrossViolation/CrossBlock path, which implements the amended rule's alphabetic/alphanumeric exception. Diagnostics cite §2023:15.63.3 r2 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probe src/allrmmix.cob at --std 85 (runs/allrmmix-001): DISPLAY FUNCTION MIN (N-EL (ALL) (1:1) A-ITEM) is REFUSED with COBOL1627 'FUNCTION MIN argument-2 is of class alphanumeric, which cannot agree with the earlier arguments', though argument-1's elements are class alphanumeric (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR3a, GR5) and A-ITEM is class alphabetic, a mix §1989:A.2.27.3 AR1 explicitly allows (rejects legal source). In src/allrmmax.cob, MIN (N-ITEM N-EL (ALL) (2:1)) draws no COBOL1627 for the numeric/alphanumeric mix; it is refused only by COBOL0900 because the compiler typed the call numeric. Identical at --std 2023 (runs/allrmmix-002). Non-ALL control MIN (N-ITEM (1:2) X-ITEM) -> 19 and MIN ("9" N-ITEM (2:3)) -> 9 are right (runs/rmmaxok-002). cite.py: 'OK  §1989:A.2.27.3 AR1  (2.27.3 Arguments)  the text is in AR1'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR3a ...'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 ...'.
refuter.corrected: NON-CONFORMING (rejects-legal-source), cause (c): same ClassOfPlace defect as MAX (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs#ClassOfPlace classes TableAllPlace over RefModPlace as the numeric element). Same at --std 2023.

adjudication.reason: A reference-modified element under an ALL subscript (`N-EL (ALL) (1:1)`) is class alphanumeric by the 1985 text, and the argument-class screen classes it as its numeric element. MAX and MIN refuse legal lists; MEAN, MEDIAN and MIDRANGE compute from digit slices; an illegal MAX mix compiles and fails at run time. Not the mechanism of PB5780 or PB5813.
